grade.stack_chosen: C# .NET 8 isolated worker Azure Function with a Service Bus trigger, shared singleton SendGrid and Notification Hubs clients, email and push sent in parallel
red_flags_hit: Ignoring the sale-day burst-scaling behaviour and focusing only on single-instance startup
grade.notes: The agent stayed on .NET isolated with reused clients, said the 2-second target needs a hosting change (Flex always-ready or Premium) rather than a Node/Go rewrite, and left that cost decision to the team. It blamed the first message after a quiet period instead of scale-out cold starts during 200/s bursts, and it never mentioned measuring latency, ReadyToRun, the cost of keeping only this app warm, or provider throttling at 200/s.
